findings.problem: The two theorems run the same argument. Both fetch IsLocallyNoetherian for the base, get GeometricallyIntegral of the base-changed projection from pullback_fst, and then apply GeometricallyIntegral.isIntegral_of_isLocallyNoetherian to that projection. Only the base scheme and the choice of projection change. Mathlib already packages this as instances: IsIntegral (pullback f g) from GeometricallyIntegral f, Flat f and UniversallyOpen f with IsIntegral Y and IsLocallyNoetherian Y, and the symmetric one for g. The file therefore re-proves the step by hand twice.
findings.proposed_change: Rely on the Mathlib instances for IsIntegral (pullback f g). The first instance has f := q, g := q and Y := X, so pullback q q is integral once IsIntegral X and IsLocallyNoetherian X are in scope. The second has g := q and X := pullback q q, so pullback (pullback.fst q q ≫ q) q is integral once IsIntegral (pullback q q) and IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback q q) are in scope. isIntegral_pullback₂ should then reduce to the two haveI lines for X followed by `inferInstance`. isIntegral_pullback₃ should reduce to `haveI := isIntegral_pullback₂ q`, `haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback q q) := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.fst q q)`, and `inferInstance`. If instance search fails, state one local helper such as: for g : Y ⟶ Spec R with [IsIntegral Y] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] and q smooth and geometrically integral, IsIntegral (pullback g q). Its proof is the repeated three-line block applied to pullback.fst g q. Both theorems become one-line specialisations of it, with g := q and g := pullback.fst q q ≫ q.
findings.benefit: The pullback_fst plus isIntegral_of_isLocallyNoetherian argument is stated once, or not at all, instead of being copied into each theorem. A future isIntegral_pullback₄ would need no new boilerplate. A reader sees that these are instances of Mathlib's integrality-of-pullback fact.

instance [GeometricallyIntegral g] [Flat g] [UniversallyOpen g]
    [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] :
    IsIntegral (pullback f g) :=
  GeometricallyIntegral.isIntegral_of_isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.fst _ _)

instance [GeometricallyIntegral f] [Flat f] [UniversallyOpen f] [IsIntegral Y]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] : IsIntegral (pullback f g) :=
